subject: Post-call: sync + rotating demo windows for Ava Health
messages:
From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Liang <sophia@avahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: sync + rotating demo windows for Ava Health

Hi Sophia — great to meet you and Oliver on the call earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks.

Recap (60-minute discovery):
- Key goals: lower inference cost per request for your triage pipeline, reduce tail latency spikes for concurrent clinical queries, and ensure private deployment options for PHI-handling flows.
- Success criteria: 250ms median token latency at 10 tps in Dedicated pool; <5% tail latency variance, and verifiable audit logs for data retention 30/90/365 day options.
- Stakeholders interested: Oliver (CTO) for architecture, Jamie (ML lead) for model/eval criteria, and Security team for SOC2 artifacts.

Immediate ask: schedule a 45–60 minute technical deep dive / demo that includes a short architecture review + live inference run with a representative workload. Because your team spans US/EU/APAC, I wanted to propose a rotating window approach so we alternate a region-friendly slot each week and keep calendar fairness for regular syncs.

Proposed timing & structure (high level):
- Duration: 45 minutes (20m demo + 20m technical Q&A + 5m ops next steps)
- Rotation model: rotate the "prime" slot weekly across US / EU / APAC so each region occasionally gets a convenient local time for live demos and deep dives.
- Roles to include on our side: myself (AE), Vivek (solutions architect) for kernel/latency discussion, Monica (CS) for rollout/ops.

Next steps:
1) Could you confirm who will attend the deep dive (Oliver, Jamie, anyone from Security)?
2) Below I included three concrete rotation proposals in a follow-up email — if you prefer, pick the option you like and we’ll send calendar invites.
3) I attached a quick availability grid and a short proposal PDF with the rotation template for you to review.

Attachments: rotating-windows-proposal.pdf (1 page), availability-grid-UTC.png (PNG)

Thanks again — I’ll follow up shortly with detailed slot options.

—Connor Obrien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

From: Sophia Liang <sophia@avahealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@avahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2027 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: sync + rotating demo windows for Ava Health

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. Oliver will join for the architecture portion; Jamie (ML) will join the tech Q&A. Our Security lead will want the SOC2 checklist in advance, but we don’t need them on this first session.

Availability constraints:
- Preferred days: Tue or Thu local (EMEA prefers Tue/Thu mornings CET).
- Timeband preference: For EMEA folks, 16:00–18:00 CET works best; for APAC, mornings 09:00–11:00 SGT are ideal.
- We have an internal weekly all-hands on Wednesdays so avoid that.

If you can propose a rotating schedule that gives the EU folks a morning CET slot at least once every three weeks, that would help with buy-in.

Also: please add a short slide or section on data retention & KMS integration — our security and infra teams will want to see that.

Thanks,
Sophia Liang
Head of Platform Integrations | Ava Health
sophia@avahealth.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Liang <sophia@avahealth.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@avahealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: sync + rotating demo windows for Ava Health

Thanks — helpful constraints. Below are three concrete rotation options; each assumes a recurring 45-minute weekly slot with the prime region rotating on a 3-week cycle. I mapped local times for the three attendees we expect.

Option A — Weekly 3-week rotation (30–45m) — balanced prime windows
- Week 1 (US prime): Tue 09:00 PDT / Tue 12:00 EDT / Tue 18:00 CET / Wed 01:00 SGT
- Week 2 (EU prime): Tue 16:00 CET / Tue 07:00 PDT / Tue 10:00 EDT / Wed 00:00 SGT
- Week 3 (APAC prime): Wed 09:30 SGT / Tue 18:30 CET / Tue 09:30 PDT

Option B — Biweekly alternating (gives two weeks same region)
- Even weeks: Tue 10:00 PDT (US-focused) — translates to Tue 19:00 CET / Wed 02:00 SGT
- Odd weeks: Tue 16:00 CET (EU-focused) — translates to Tue 07:00 PDT / Tue 10:00 EDT / Wed 00:00 SGT

Option C — Fixed rotating blocks with a daytime EU slot every 3rd week (per your ask)
- Week pattern: US / EU / APAC where Week 2 always includes a morning CET window for EU participants (example: Tue 09:30 CET = Tue 00:30 PDT / Tue 03:30 EDT / Tue 16:30 SGT)

Practical notes:
- We can run the live inference demo against a small redwood-hosted test repo you provide or against a redacted sample dataset. Please let us know if you have any strict network access constraints (we can do VPC peering/private deploy demos if needed).
- I created a short scheduling poll (link below) and attached an ICS option to let you snapshot whichever recurring pattern you prefer.

Scheduling poll & materials: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/rotating-demo-poll
Attachments: rotating-windows-proposal.pdf (updated with the three options), redwood-demo-poll-link.txt (poll link), availability-grid-UTC.png

If you like Option A I’ll go ahead and send calendar invites for the first three occurrences and loop in our SRE/solutions folks for the technical deep dive. Monica will prepare an ops/retention slide covering KMS & retention windows. Vivek will handle runtime performance details.

—Connor

From: Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@avahealth.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sophia Liang <sophia@avahealth.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@avahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 02:40:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: sync + rotating demo windows for Ava Health

Connor / Sophia — thanks. Option A looks reasonable to start. We’d like the first demo to include:
- Jamie (ML) for model/eval questions (cc'd)
- A short network/data-retention slide (Sophia asked this)
- If possible, run the live inference using a small redacted sample — Jamie will upload that to the Drive link you provided.

Preference: please send the initial three occurrences as calendar invites in CET (our operations team prefers one canonical timezone in invites). We’ll accept and forward as needed.

I’m OK with Tue 09:00 PDT / Tue 18:00 CET for the first occurrence (Option A Week 1 mapping). Please add Vivek and Monica and include the ICS.

Oliver Chen
CTO | Ava Health
oliver.chen@avahealth.com
